info.title: pnfmt
info.description: Format .NET project, solution, resource, and configuration files.

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recurse into subdirectories when a path is a directory.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed per-file logging and errors.

options.name: -maxCpuCount
options.description: Process up to N files concurrently; omit N to use all CPUs.

options.name: --file-pattern
options.description: Include only files matching the glob; repeat to include more.

options.name: --formatter
options.description:
Enable only the named formatters; repeat or use comma-separated names.
Available names: csproj, ini, resx, slnx.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would change without writing files.

options.name: --check
options.description: Exit with code 1 if any file would change (implies --dry-run).

options.name: --lint
options.description: Report project diagnostics and formatting changes; exit 1 if found.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version info.
Notes:
If no path is provided, the current directory is used.
Registered formatters support .csproj, .resx, .slnx, .editorconfig, and .ini files.
Project and resource formatting runs only when EditorConfig enables it.
Shared settings use pnfmt_; format-specific settings add csproj_ or resx_.
Legacy formatter settings remain fallbacks and produce warnings.
